title: Thrust Reverser Blocker Door Link — Installation and Deployment Timing

issue.reason: Issue C. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Installation of the blocker door links with the rigging check and the deployment timing that compares the two halves against each other, which is how an early bushing problem shows itself.

sections.purpose: This task installs the blocker door links, rigs the blocker doors and proves the installation by a deployment test in which the timing of both halves is compared.
sections.job_setup_note: The deployment timing of the two halves is the diagnostic. A difference between the halves that is inside the absolute limit but larger than the previous record is the first sign of link wear, so the previous record must be available before the test is run. Do not remove the lockout until step 9.
sections.procedure: 1. Confirm that the lockout is still fitted and that the serial number matches the removal record. 2. Clean the link housing bores and check them for pick-up. 3. Install each link on its pin with the clevis pin EN768314K5 and a new retention. Do not reuse a retention. 4. Where the self-lubricating bushing standard applies, confirm that the bushing is fully seated and that the link is free to rotate by hand without slack. CAUTION: A LINK THAT IS TIGHT BY HAND WILL BIND UNDER LOAD AND WILL LOAD THE BLOCKER DOOR HINGE. DO NOT ACCEPT A TIGHT LINK. 5. Install the aft seal D7830117902757 and secure the retainer with the countersunk washers AGS5451K6 at every position. 6. Where the nozzle kit D7830110928662 was disturbed, refit it and torque the retainer fasteners to the value given. 7. Rig the blocker doors to the dimension in the limits table and check that all doors sit within the range across the half. 8. Close the reverser half and remove the support strut. 9. Remove the lockout, record the serial number and reactivate the reverser. WARNING: KEEP EVERYONE CLEAR OF THE REVERSER BEFORE THE LOCKOUT IS REMOVED AND THE SYSTEM IS REACTIVATED. 10. Do three full deployment and stow cycles and time each one on both halves. 11. Record the six timings and compare the two halves against each other and against the previous record for the engine. 12. Where the difference between halves has grown by more than the figure in the table since the previous record, do not release the engine; investigate the links. 13. Refit the seal 6577ET and check the mount link 83ET before closing.
sections.close_out: Record the six deployment timings, the rigging dimensions and the lockout serial numbers on removal and refit. Enter the half-to-half timing difference in the engine record so that the next crew has a trend to compare against.

type_data.effectivity_note: SOLANO-30 and SOLANO-34 aircraft; step 4 applies only to the self-lubricating bushing standard

safety_precautions: Keep everyone clear before the lockout is removed.
Support the reverser half on the strut.
Do not reuse a pin retention.
